confirmedFindings.title: Concurrent unsynchronized slice append causes data race and memory corruption
confirmedFindings.body: Multiple goroutines append to the results slice concurrently without mutex locking or pre-allocated indexed slots, causing data races and corrupted slice memory headers.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Use a mutex around slice append, pre-allocate results := make([]string, len(items)) and index results[i] = ..., or collect items through a channel.
